annotations.title: DoD CDRL (DD Form 1423) & Data Item Description (DID) Schedule Extractor

description: Extract all Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL / DD Form 1423) items from DoD RFPs, maps Data Item Descriptions (DIDs), Block 4 authority, submission frequencies, inspection/acceptance codes, and builds a WBS Data Delivery Calendar. Returns a strictly validated `CdrlDd1423Response` JSON object containing `cdrl_schedule_overview`, `dd_form_1423_extracted_items`, `did_tailoring_and_delivery_calendar`, and `piee_wawf_and_block18_pricing_governance` grounded in DFARS Subpart 227.71, DoD 5010.12-M (Procedures for the Acquisition and Management of Technical Data), & ASSIST DID Registry. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive GovCon compliance and capture analysis call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key or X-SignalTender-Key; `rfp_exhibit_a_cdrl_and_pws_text` accepts 15 to 45,000 characters, while `contract_award_and_pop_start_context` and `dd1423_pricing_group_strategy` calibrate the regulatory regime and threshold assumptions). Use this tool when executing DoD CDRL (DD Form 1423) & Data Item Description (DID) Schedule Extractor workflows; use `scan_far_dfars_clauses` instead for general FAR/DFARS clause flow-down audits, or `generate_compliance_matrix` for general Section L/M 'shall' requirement extraction.

contract_award_and_pop_start_context.default: Contract Award / Post-Award Conference (PAC) = Day 0; 12-Month Base Period + 4 Option Years
contract_award_and_pop_start_context.description: Target regulatory regime, statutory authority, or evaluation framework (defaults to 'Contract Award / Post-Award Conference (PAC) = Day 0; 12-Month Base Period + 4 Option Years').

dd1423_pricing_group_strategy.default: Map DD Form 1423 Block 18 Price Groups (Group I, II, III, IV — NSP vs. Separately Priced Data CLIN)
dd1423_pricing_group_strategy.description: Operational context, threshold parameters, or compliance posture assumptions (defaults to 'Map DD Form 1423 Block 18 Price Groups (Group I, II, III, IV — NSP vs. Separately Priced Data CLIN)').

rfp_exhibit_a_cdrl_and_pws_text.description: Primary solicitation text, clause excerpts, deliverable schedule, or technical/financial context for DoD CDRL (DD Form 1423) & Data Item Description (DID) Schedule Extractor (15 to 45,000 characters).

name: generate_cdrls_did_data_deliverables

cdrl_schedule_overview.description: Executive determination overview, regulatory citations, and readiness score.

dd_form_1423_extracted_items.description: Structured line-by-line regulatory audit, classification, or quantitative schedule rows.

did_tailoring_and_delivery_calendar.description: Paste-ready compliance narratives, control specifications, or submission sections.

piee_wawf_and_block18_pricing_governance.description: Statutory governance protocol and actionable submission verification checklist.
